name: newtabtools
description: A new tab page for Firefox, built around the sites you actually visit and laid out the way you want. PowerTools for your New Tab page.

scripts.test: npm run test:fast && npm run test:e2e
scripts.update-zip:
VER=$(node -p "require('@zip.js/zip.js/package.json').version") && printf '/*
 * @zip.js/zip.js v%s — zip-core.min.js
 * Source: https://github.com/gildas-lormeau/zip.js
 * License: BSD-3-Clause
 * Installed as devDependency; copied via: npm run update-zip
 */
' "$VER" | cat - node_modules/@zip.js/zip.js/dist/zip-core.min.js > webextension/lib/zip.js
